title: chore: update app metrics 2026-10-04
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt: Daily automated update of app request and repository metrics

gist.headline: The garden keeps count
gist.blurb: The daily app tally gets another entry. Even gardens have spreadsheets.
gist.summary: The automated October 4, 2026 update refreshes app request and repository metrics in operations/app-management/app.json for internal tracking.
gist.impact: The team gets current app request and repository metrics; this does not change app behavior.
gist.visual_concept: Depict an internal metrics ledger rather than a new app feature: Polli checks a small tally of app requests beside a repository-shaped code plant in a cozy garden shed.
